name: Theseus Robotics
long_description: Theseus Robotics creates the OS & Physical AI to deploys humanoids to automate menial tasks in supermarkets. During the day, our robotics pick orders for e-grocery orders. Overnight, they restocks shelves with goods from the back warehouse.
one_liner: Humanoids to restock retail shelves & pick orders

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder/CEO at Theseus Robotics. Previously founded and scaled Parts World USA from sub-$100k to $3M revenue in 4 years by building global supply chains across China, India, Vietnam, Malaysia & USA. Founded Jumps Tronic (hardware manufacturing). Worked on ML at Facebook and HP. BS in Computer Science from Carnegie Mellon; Dropped out of ETH Zürich.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Founder/CTO at Theseus Robotics. Ex. VP of Technology at ETH Robotics Club, leading development of 6 technical divisions including Switzerland's first fully-Swiss humanoid robot. Previously Research Assistant at ETH Zürich's Intelligent Control Systems Group, focusing on high-performance learning-based control. MSc in Robotics, Systems and Control at ETH Zürich.

founders.title: Founder/CPO
founders.founder_bio: Founder/CPO at Theseus Robotics. Previously robotics engineer at Flink Robotics, where he led deployment of a pick-and-place system at live sorting centers achieving 800 picks/hour matching human performance. Designed full robotic work-cells and built custom pneumatic grippers. Published ML research on vehicle dynamics at IFAC SYSID 2024. MA in Robotics from ETH Zürich.
